info.title: CareIQ local workflow API
info.description: Authoritative implemented local workflow contract. Clerk staff bearer and independently scoped patient session cookie. No hosted deployment, real email/SMS sends or certificate-based signature claims. See docs/design/workflow/runtime-contract.md for operations, scan/provider adapters and activation limits. Schema-v2 guided forms and explicit patient-paperwork grants are local implementation extensions. Provider delivery, alternate signer authority, uploaded-PDF overlay authoring and external archival activation remain gated.

bearerAuth.description: Verified Clerk session for current org, with fresh membership/enrollment/location assignment and specific action permission.

patientSession.name: careiq_patient_session
patientSession.description: HttpOnly request-scoped cookie established only through session-exchanges; cannot authorize staff endpoints.

paperworkManage.description: Dedicated org:paperwork:manage plus workflow configuration and document read access. Recent authentication is separately enforced by portal-management routes.

localReviewPath.description: Local review link returned only at initial grant issuance. Never stored in retry/audit records; omitted on replay.

expectedDraftRevision.description: Required for schema-v2 publication; must equal the exact selected draft revision. The template If-Match is also required.

verificationMethod.description: Legacy signature requests retain email_link. New v2 form-completion signing uses patient_request_link, including local review issuance. Neither value upgrades link_possession assurance or establishes email delivery or independently verified identity.

value.description: Type-specific value. Drawn signatures require a base64 PNG data URL; the 150000-character limit is additional to dimension/pixel/inflation checks.

PatientCompletion.description: Explicit consent and exact source/revision are required. Local generated/signing PDF output is capped at 100 pages. Drawn signatures accept bounded, non-animated, non-interlaced PNGs up to 2048 by 1024 with at most 1,048,576 pixels; compressed inflation and image metadata are checked before embedding. Unavailable assurance policies remain fail-closed.

documentTitle.description: Pinned version title derived by the server and included in the immutable publication hash.

FormSchema.description: Guided schema v2. Server validates unique stable IDs, acyclic applicability, repeated-item bounds, binding types and signing requirements. Required patient signing needs frozen consent wording/version. Unsupported overlay geometry, arbitrary script and alternate signer roles fail closed.

FormDecisionCommand.description: Acceptance additionally requires the current patient revision. Candidate and patient mutations, decision evidence and protected audit commit atomically. Patient-reported facts are not applied automatically.

Status400.description: Malformed request, invalid UUID/cursor or missing retry key

Status404.description: Record missing or out of scope

Status409.description: Business state, provider overlap, retry fingerprint or version conflict

Status503.description: Database, audit, storage or authorization dependency unavailable

Status500.description: Unexpected local service failure; protected content is not released.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUIDv4, unique per actor/scope command. Same target/payload/precondition safely replays after current authorization; reuse with changed target/payload conflicts.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact editable aggregate revision. Missing returns428; stale returns412. Valid idempotent replay precedes old revision check.

x-contract-notes: Unknown mutation fields are rejected. Staff workflow JSON limit256KiB; patient workflow JSON limit256KiB; binary uploads10MiB.
All protected reads audit exact returned IDs/versions before response. Failures/denials append separately after rollback.
Collection cursors bind actor, membership, tenant/location, filters, collection and page limit. Default50/max100. SQL totals cover all filtered rows, independent of page.
Local scanner exit0 clean,1 unsafe; unavailable/error/unknown quarantines. Unconfigured delivery records failed provider attempt and local outbox, never a fake delivery.
Current version selection after stale upload requires explicit revision and reason. Immutable previous bytes/reviews/evidence remain.
